content:
priya: Heads-up — since the 11:30 deploy we're seeing p95 token latency jump ~180ms on long-context r/w workloads. stacks point at KV pager/evict hot path.

dmitri: Which policy is live? LRU or FIFO?

priya: FIFO on the fleet we're hitting. Reproduces with long chat sessions (8k+ tokens) and lots of small writes.

alex: I remember a flake where FIFO reinserts were creating orphaned segments under heavy paging. Could be fragmentation + reuse starvation.

priya: Logs show repeated page-in/page-out churn. Example from one host: 
```
kv_pager: evict batch=128 freed=0 reinserted=27 pages_swapped=18 stall_ms=72
kv_cache: reuse_hit_rate=0.041 allocs=12345
```

sasha: reuse_hit_rate that low is bad. Sounds like eviction is evicting things that are immediately reused (reinsert churn).

perf-bot: Profiling snapshot uploaded: https://internal.perf/reports/2160001234 (flame + timeline) :mag:

dmitri: Can you paste the small flame summary? I want to see whether eviction is synchronous on the request path or async background.

priya: Flame highlights: ~25% time in kv_reinsert_sync during high concurrency samples, spikes aligned with p95. Background pager threads also run, but primary latency correlates with caller stalls waiting for eviction completion.

alex: That suggests our FIFO reinsert path is synchronous when the slot is occupied. Under pressure FIFO does a chain-reinsert which traverses slab lists and can trigger page faults. LRU would bump instead of reinserting, so different memory touches.

priya: We tried toggling to LRU on a single canary; p95 dropped ~120ms. But noticed higher memory footprint and more fragmentation over long contexts.

sasha: Tradeoffs: FIFO keeps lower steady-state memory but worse latency under bursts (reinsert chains). LRU gives latency win at cost of fragmentation/growth.

dmitri: Can we adaptively switch per-queue? E.g., low-latency route uses LRU, throughput-heavy uses FIFO. Need policy selector in router.

alex: Router-level switch seems feasible. Also we should make reinserts async where possible and add a backpressure token bucket to limit concurrent reinsert work on hot hosts.

priya: Actionable items: 
- priya: collect more host profiles and attach heap maps (in progress)
- dmitri: prototype per-queue policy toggle in staging (2d)
- alex: spike async reinsert PR (WIP)
- sasha: run long-context mem-growth test with LRU for 24h and report fragmentation numbers

perf-bot: Note: opened perf ticket PERF-3221 for KV eviction regression tracking.

priya: For now rolling back the 11:30 change on one shard and will monitor; if p95 drops we'll plan a controlled rollout of LRU for the latency-sensitive tier.

dmitri: Also capture a short (5-10 sample) eBPF syscall trace on a hot host to confirm page-fault syscall correlation.

sasha: copying notes to the incident doc: https://wiki/internal/kv-rotation-latency-2160001234

priya: thanks everyone — I'll post updates here after the rollback and the 24h runs finish. :thumbsup:
